text053: Left and right describe the economic axis. Liberty and authority describe the social axis. One does not determine the other.
text055: The role of government, markets, and resource distribution. From −100 (left) to +100 (right).
text057: Individual autonomy, institutions, and limits on power. From −100 (libertarian) to +100 (authoritarian).
text059: Answers from 1 to 5 are converted to values from −2 to +2. Each statement contributes only to its own axis, according to its direction. The sum is normalized to −100 to +100. The range −10 to +10 is the center.
text060: This is an exploratory tool using statements proposed for this project, without psychometric validation. Your result estimates your answers; it is not a definitive description of your political identity.
text061: Your ideas are enough. No personal details needed.
text062: We don't ask for your name, email, or registration. We store answers, progress, and results under a random identifier. Anyone with the result link can view it; individual answers are not displayed. Sharing clicks are counted without tracking your social accounts.
